name: 605 Clothing
old_description: We design,  develop and produce some of the most uniqe products you may ever see :) - right here in the great state of South Dakota - Or as we call it "The 605"
about:
Based in Tea, South Dakota, 605 Clothing takes its name from the state’s 605 area code. The company designs, develops, and produces a range of branded apparel and accessories from its Midwestern location, with a showroom housed at the affiliated Octane Ink facility.

The product line includes graphic t-shirts, hoodies, caps, and leather-wrapped tumblers, organized under collections such as PinHigh Golf and Vintage Tee. Most orders are manufactured on demand, while a selection of stock is kept in the showroom for immediate purchase. The company also operates a direct-to-consumer e-commerce site and offers wholesale programs for retail partners.

Customers include individual consumers purchasing through the website and retail stores seeking to carry 605 Clothing’s South Dakota-themed lifestyle and golf apparel. Wholesale inquiries are directed to a dedicated email contact, and the company promotes its products as “swag you actually want to wear.”

The brand emphasizes its local roots, positioning its merchandise as uniquely South Dakotan and produced in-house rather than outsourced overseas. This domestic, on-demand model is presented as a differentiator for both retail partners and end customers.
